account_labels.description: Optional display name per config dir, e.g. ~/.claude-work = Work. By default the name comes from the dir (~/.claude-work shows as "work").
account_labels.label: Account names

bar_limits.description: Plan usage shown on the bar widget, next to each account's sessions.
bar_limits.label: Bar limits

config_dirs.description: Claude Code config dirs (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) to always show, one per account. Dirs of running sessions are detected automatically.
config_dirs.label: Extra Claude config dirs

context_window.description: Used to draw the context gauge.
context_window.label: Context window (tokens)

finished_min_minutes.description: Only notify about turns that took at least this long.
finished_min_minutes.label: Minimum turn length (minutes)

hide_idle_hours.description: Hide live sessions idle longer than this. 0 shows all.
hide_idle_hours.label: Hide sessions idle for (hours)

notify_finished.description: Desktop notification when a session goes from working to idle.
notify_finished.label: Notify when a long turn finishes

notify_waiting.description: Desktop notification when a session starts waiting for input or a permission.
notify_waiting.label: Notify when a session needs you

recent_count.description: Closed sessions listed in the Recent section and the launcher. 0 disables it.
recent_count.label: Recent sessions to show

work_root.description: Project paths under this folder are shown relative to it. Empty shows full paths.
work_root.label: Projects root
